day_titles.5: To Paro: Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong

1: Arrival at Paro International and transfer to Thimphu
The road east along the Pa Chhu and the Wang Chhu
The riverside market halls by the Wang Chhu
Chillies, ferns and strings of dried beef
2: Breakfast, then out into the capital
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma
Tashichho Dzong and the takin preserve
3: Breakfast, then east over the Dochula pass
The hundred and eight chortens at the top
Punakha Dzong between the Pho and Mo rivers
Chimi Lhakhang across the paddy fields
4: Breakfast in the warm Punakha valley
Punakha Dzong between the Pho and Mo rivers
The long suspension bridge over the water
5: Breakfast, then west down the valley to Paro
Terraced fields and farmhouses the whole way
The round watchtower holding the National Museum
Rinpung Dzong on the slope above the river
6: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The National Museum in the old watchtower
Rinpung Dzong and the Drukgyel ruins
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Paro International for your flight home

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: A fixed departure group tour, so you travel with others and the price stays down. Two nights each in Thimphu, Punakha and Paro.
expert.tip: Two nights in Punakha is rare on a group tour. Use the spare afternoon for a float down the Mo Chhu rather than another temple.

summary: 7 days through Thimphu, Punakha, Paro, with 6 nights, all meals and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu weekend market, the thimphu sightseeing tour, the punakha dzong and chimi lhakhang, the punakha sightseeing tour.
included: Included: 6 nights across Thimphu, Punakha, Paro with all meals; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu weekend market; the Thimphu sightseeing tour; the Punakha Dzong and Chimi Lhakhang; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong; the Paro sightseeing tour; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
